description: The rules a browser game must follow to run on YouGame (build layout, paths, limits, the runtime sandbox, desktop/mobile reserved button areas, what usually breaks and how to fix it) plus how to verify and upload. Read this first when making a game YouGame-ready. The whole guide is long: pass topic (a heading such as "Desktop builds" or "Publishing from a coding agent") for just that part; an unknown topic answers with the list of headings.

topic.description: Optional: one heading of the guide, or words from it. Omit for the whole guide.
